item.title: Issah
item.description:
Mercenary. Deadpan, economical, a death-wish underneath. Travels east with Eri.

Beyond

His little brother Urmez starved to death in his arms. He earned the Dragon Slayer title through Malachar’s willing sacrifice. He kills Rhodes at the climax.
